# Toilet paper locations including map

![Toilet paper locations including map](/uploads/622_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Collecting toilet paper is often a challenge in Fallout 76. There are numerous places where you can find toilet paper. Some places are waiting for you with up to 12 toilet paper rolls.

If you regularly visit locations for challenges, you should make sure that your loot list no longer contains these items. It doesn't hurt to empty the loot list every now and then: 

Respawn of items, enemies & loot lists explained.

## Places with toilet paper

- 19x toilet paper around Whitespring Resort (north in the cabins & laundry)
- 12x toilet paper at Red Rocket Mega Stop
- 12x Toilet Paper north of Valley Galeria in and around an open safe in the water
- 8x at Settler's Ridge
- 7x at Ash Cave in Burning Springs
- 7x north in Athens
- 6x at the Starlight Drive-In
- 6x at Sunnytop ski slopes
- 6x south of West-Tek (see map)
- 5x at Aaronhold Gutshof
- 5x in Berkeley Springs West (slightly south of the workshop)
- 5x in Camp Venture
- 5x at the Shenandoah Visitor Center
- 5x at the Whitespring Golf Club
- 5x at Becker Farm
- 4x south of Harpers Ferry (in the water, see map)
- 4x Garrahan Estate
- 4x in Camden Park
- 4x in Point Pleasant
- 4x at transmission station 1AT-U03 (next to Tyler County)
- 3x at Sutton train station
- 3x between Dino Peaks and Athens in Burning Springs (see map)
- 3x at The Chop Shop in Burning Springs
- 3x in Corn World in Burning Springs
- 3x east of Becker Farm
- 3x at Grafton train station
- 3x in Clarksburg
- 3x at Bailey's family cabin
- 3x at Foundation
- 3x at Mountainside Bed & Breakfast
- 3x at Big Bend Tunnel West
- 3x at the Charleston train station
- Many more places: see map
